subject: business

courseOpsExtract.lessonTypeReason: First class of the course; teacher introduced course outline, class rules, Schoolology platform, and conducted ice-breaker self-introductions. Main instructional content was administrative and orientation, not core academic mastery. Homework assigned (KWL chart) is pre-assessment, not exit card.

opsItems.title: Complete KWL Chart (First Two Columns) for Unit 1: Foundations of Management
opsItems.studentAction: Download the KWL chart from Unit 1 Lesson folder, fill in 'What I Know' and 'What I Wonder' columns with bullet points, and submit to Unit 1 & Lesson 1 submission folder on Schoolology.
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'I will just leave you guys one little homework... KWL chart... only finish the first two columns... submit it to the unit one and last some one folder.'

opsItems.title: Class Attendance and Camera Policy
opsItems.studentAction: Arrive around 8:05-8:07; camera must be on during class (except breaks). If late, leave a note in chat. If absent, email Catherine or inform campus Chinese teacher/teaching assistant.
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'camera has to be on... if you're showing up after that... leave me a note... if you have to be absent... email me in the event... or reach out to Jessie or any of your campus Chinese teacher.'

opsItems.title: Late Assignment Policy
opsItems.studentAction: Email teacher 24 hours in advance for extension. Late submission: 5% deduction per day, max 20% deduction.
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'email me in advance, 24 hours in advance... one day will be 5%... max I will only deduct you 20%... including the weekends.'

opsItems.title: Plagiarism Policy (First Offense)
opsItems.studentAction: Avoid plagiarism (direct copying, paraphrasing without attribution, using others' ideas without permission, AI-generated work). First offense: 10% mark deduction and mandatory resubmission.
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'first offense... 10% of the marks gone... mandatory to resubmit it.'

opsItems.title: Tomorrow's Class: Citation and References
opsItems.studentAction: Be prepared for a dry but important class on citation and references; bring coffee if needed.
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'tomorrow we're going to officially start with our research scale techniques for the citation and references... it might be a little bit dry... grab a coffee.'

opsItems.title: Teacher Email for Communication
opsItems.studentAction: Use teacher email for extensions, absences, or questions. (Email provided in chat.)
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'I'm gonna to give you guys my email... Catherine dot w Queens... I posted to the chat.' but actual email not fully captured.

opsItems.title: Break Policy and Class Flow
opsItems.studentAction: Break of 15 minutes will be given; if not provided, class will end 15 minutes early.
opsItems.sourceEvidence: Teacher: 'I will be giving you the guys the break for 15 minutes... If I don't, I will always save it to the last, the last 15 minutes block.'

title: BOH4M Exit Card Readiness Package
problemAnchor: 本节课主要检查学生是否知道考试、作业、提交、材料或平台等下一步要求。

abt.and: 你已经收到本节课的重要安排。
abt.but: 如果错过材料、平台、截止日期或考试要求，学习表现会被非知识因素影响。
abt.therefore: 系统先确认你是否知道下一步行动；不通过时触发提醒或人工确认。

objective: 学生能确认本节课后的关键行动、材料、平台、截止日期或考试要求。

learningGoals.statement: Understand where to submit the KWL chart homework and the deadline.
Know the camera and attendance policies.
Know the late assignment and plagiarism policies.
Be aware of tomorrow's class topic and how to contact the teacher.

diagnosisRules.condition: student chooses a wrong submission folder
diagnosisRules.systemAction: send reminder with correct submission folder link
diagnosisRules.studentMessage: Reminder: Please submit your KWL chart to the 'Unit 1 & Lesson 1' submission folder on Schoolology.

diagnosisRules.condition: student says camera is not required
diagnosisRules.systemAction: ask teacher or TA to confirm understanding with the student
diagnosisRules.studentMessage: Please remember: cameras must be on during class (except breaks). Let your teacher know if you have any issues.

diagnosisRules.condition: student chooses a wrong action for extension
diagnosisRules.systemAction: send reminder of the 24-hour email policy
diagnosisRules.studentMessage: If you need an assignment extension, please email Catherine at least 24 hours in advance.

diagnosisRules.condition: student chooses a wrong penalty for first plagiarism offense
diagnosisRules.systemAction: ask teacher or TA to review plagiarism policy with the student
diagnosisRules.studentMessage: First plagiarism offense: 10% deduction and mandatory resubmission. Please check the policy again.

diagnosisRules.condition: student chooses a wrong topic for tomorrow
diagnosisRules.studentMessage: Tomorrow's class will be on citation and references. Please come prepared!
The teacher's email is: Catherine dot w Queens (as shared in chat). You can use it for extensions, absences, or questions.

questions.stem: Where should you submit your completed KWL chart (first two columns)?
questions.learningGoal: Understand where to submit the KWL chart homework and the deadline.
questions.successCriteria: Student selects the correct submission folder.
questions.stemIntent: Check if students know where to submit homework on Schoolology.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think they submit in the lesson folder or general assignments.

options.label: Lesson folder inside Unit 1
options.feedbackWrong: The lesson folder contains the slides and homework questions, but submissions go to the submission folder.

options.label: General Schoolology dropbox
options.feedbackWrong: Each unit has its own submission folder. Please use the Unit 1 & Lesson 1 folder.

options.label: Email it to the teacher
options.feedbackWrong: Homework should be submitted on Schoolology, not via email.

questions.stem: Is it required to have your camera on during class?
questions.learningGoal: Know the camera and attendance policies.
questions.successCriteria: Student selects that camera must be on.
questions.stemIntent: Check understanding of the camera policy.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think camera is optional or only during attendance.

options.label: Yes, cameras must be on at all times during class (except breaks)
Only during attendance
options.feedbackWrong: Camera must be on for the whole class, not just attendance.

options.label: No, it's optional
options.feedbackWrong: Camera must be on as per class policy.

questions.stem: If you need an extension on an assignment, what should you do?
questions.successCriteria: Student selects emailing 24 hours in advance.
questions.stemIntent: Check if students know the late assignment extension procedure.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think they can ask during class or just submit late without notice.

options.label: Ask the TA during class
options.feedbackWrong: You must email the teacher in advance, not ask in class.

options.label: Just submit it late; the penalty is 5% per day
options.feedbackWrong: You should request an extension before the deadline to avoid penalty.

options.label: Post on the discussion board
options.feedbackWrong: Extensions must be requested by email, not on the discussion board.

questions.stem: What is the consequence for a first offense of plagiarism?
questions.successCriteria: Student selects 10% deduction and mandatory resubmission.
questions.stemIntent: Check if students know the penalty for first-time plagiarism.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think it's a warning or lower penalty.

options.label: A warning letter only
options.feedbackWrong: First offense includes a 10% deduction and resubmission, not just a warning.

options.label: 20% mark deduction
options.feedbackWrong: 20% deduction is for second or further offenses.

options.label: Automatic zero on the assignment
options.feedbackWrong: First offense: 10% deduction and chance to resubmit.

questions.stem: What is the topic of tomorrow's class?
questions.learningGoal: Be aware of tomorrow's class topic.
questions.stemIntent: Check if students recall the upcoming lesson.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think it continues with course outline or management fundamentals.

options.label: Unit 1: Management Fundamentals
options.feedbackWrong: We will start Unit 1 content later; tomorrow focuses on citation and references.

options.label: Group project introduction
options.feedbackWrong: Tomorrow is about citation skills, not group projects.

options.label: Leadership theories
options.feedbackWrong: Leadership is covered in Unit 2, not tomorrow.

questions.stem: What is Catherine's email address (as shared in the chat)?
questions.learningGoal: Know how to contact the teacher.
questions.successCriteria: Student selects the correct email approximation.
questions.stemIntent: Check if students noted the teacher's email.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might confuse with other emails or think it's provided later.

options.label: catherine.wang@school.edu
options.feedbackWrong: The email is 'Catherine dot w Queens' as shared in chat.

options.label: catherine@queens.ca
options.feedbackWrong: Please check the chat for the exact email.

options.label: We don't have the email yet
options.feedbackWrong: The email was provided in the chat during class.
